title: HideBox
summary: Browser-encrypted file drive and paid-access shops. November 14 read-only service metadata identifies hidebox.app as Ootle mainnet (network byte 0, testnet false), with SealLog component 45efaa40…4690; Veil displays SealLog template 494d34a5…c8472 at epoch 38542. The separate testnet.hidebox.app metadata identifies Esmeralda (byte 38, testnet true). The newer November 12 creator announcement describes mainnet market and offline shop delivery; the repository README still describes the earlier Esmeralda stage. Mainnet beta purchases have no refunds. Save the browser key: losing it loses access. The server sees padded sizes, timing and sharing rules; offline shop delivery is server-visible, and the server can open public-shop files. Sponsored sends can be linked, and deletion receipts cannot prove no copy was kept. MIT source. The November 14 recording walks through the creator announcement, not an upload, purchase or wallet interaction. Earlier testnet footage and observations remain in maintenance history.
cardSummary: Store encrypted files and share access through links, recipient addresses, paid unlocks and digital shops.
